competencyStatement: Determine how to measure, analyze, and improve EHS culture
placementNote: No authoritative D02 topic/subtopic StudyContent tree is admitted into FCP. Topic and subtopic placement remain unset.

locators: Top management can demonstrate its commitment
Action item 2: Encourage workers to report safety and health concerns
Action item 4: Involve workers in all aspects of the program
Action item 5: Remove barriers to participation
leading indicators are proactive and preventive measures

candidateConcepts.rationale: The enduring organizational values, expectations, priorities, and practices that shape how safety is understood and acted upon.
Shared employee perceptions of what is rewarded, expected, valued, and reinforced regarding safety; a measurable snapshot of the wider culture.
Structured assessment of safety-climate factors to identify maturity, strengths, and low-scoring areas needing intervention.
Visible leadership actions that demonstrate safety is important through decisions, resources, communication, recognition, and example.
Alignment and integration of safety into organizational priorities and routine decisions rather than treating it as an isolated program.
Clear expectations and responsibility for safety performance at all organizational levels.
Meaningful involvement of workers in reporting, evaluating, designing, operating, and improving safety and health activities.
Two-way exchange of safety information, concerns, feedback, and management responses that supports trust and informed action.
Using reports, evaluation findings, worker knowledge, and feedback to change systems and improve safety performance.
A repeatable assess-prioritize-intervene-reassess cycle used to strengthen weak culture or climate factors and evaluate whether changes worked.

crossCompetencyReferences.reason: C03 uses measures to assess culture, but the generic Performance Measure concept is already canonical in D02 C01.
Culture data require analysis, but the generic Performance Analysis concept is already canonical in D02 C02.
Culture improvement may use an action plan, but Action Plan is already canonical in D02 C02.
Safety climate can function as a leading indicator, but the generic indicator concept belongs to D02 C07.
